title: Grateful Dead Live at Fresno Convention Center on 1969-06-13
lineage: Master Soundboard Cassette > Cass > DAT > ZA2 > SF > CD

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1969 show with standout Schoolgirl, St. Stephen, The Eleven and a monster Lovelight; crisp soundboard recording despite occasional tuning hiccups.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for Jerry’s ferocious guitar work, Pigpen’s superb organ on “Sittin’ on Top of the World,” and an epic 21‑minute “Lovelight” that caps a night fueled by guest vocals. The soundboard source is generally clear and well‑balanced, though listeners note some feedback and out‑of‑tune moments in the mid‑set.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars, highlighting strong musical moments and good sound quality; a few lower scores mention tuning issues but do not outweigh the overall enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with top‑notch clarity; occasional feedback around 13 min and some out‑of‑tune guitar heads on early songs, but overall a solid soundboard capture.

standout_songs: Sittin' on Top of the World
poor_songs: Morning Dew (tuning issues noted by some listeners)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early songs are tight, the band builds momentum through St. Stephen and The Eleven, leading to a soaring Lovelight finale; guest singers add texture without disrupting flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Tearing it up on guitar, panther‑like stage presence, leads the epic Lovelight with ferocious solos.
band_member_comments.Phil: Valiantly ripping bass lines; overall solid but some tuning issues in the mid‑set affect his sound.
band_member_comments.Bob: Pigpen shines on organ (especially “Sittin' on Top of the World”), vocals clear despite jokes, adds gritty texture.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s keyboards are clearly heard throughout; guest flute adds a nice color.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy and Mickey keep a dancing rhythm, though loose machine heads cause occasional out‑of‑tune moments.
